SecondaryUserResult.ExceptionMessage: Key not valid for use in specified state.
SecondaryUserResult.Meaning: Key not valid for use in specified state (User Master Key does not match cipher owner SID)

SecurityConclusion.CrossUserIsolation: ENFORCED (User B cannot decrypt User A's credentials even with local read permission)
SecurityConclusion.BackupRestore: Restoring ciphertext to another machine will trigger NTE_BAD_KEY_STATE (0x8009000B); app must cleanly detect and ask user to re-authenticate
SecurityConclusion.DPAPIBoundTo: Windows User Account SID + User Profile Master Key (%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Protect\{SID})
SecurityConclusion.MachineMigration: CANNOT BE DECRYPTED on a different machine or user profile without original DPAPI master keys
